description: This is a shell script designed for setting up labels on a GitHub repository, including creating component, workflow, and scope labels, as well as removing legacy labels.

methods.name: create_label
methods.description: Creates a new label on GitHub with specified name, color, and description, or simulates creation in dry-run mode.

methods.name: delete_label
methods.description: Deletes a specified label from GitHub or simulates deletion in dry-run mode.
